svg.title: Mizoroki–Heck coupling: Oxidative addition
svg.desc: LnPd(0) + Ph–Br → LnPd(II)(Ph)(Br). Oxidative addition makes Pd–C/Pd–Br bonds and raises formal Pd oxidation state. Ligand dissociation/association and spin/speciation are not reduced to a molecular SN2 code.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Oxidative addition makes Pd–C/Pd–Br bonds and raises formal Pd oxidation state. Ligand
dissociation/association and spin/speciation are not reduced to a molecular SN2 code.
